queries: SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status;
SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS attendees, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status;

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS attendees FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status) SELECT status, attendees, attendees * 1.0 / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts
